{{wiktionary|Bernstein}}
'''Bernstein''' is a common surname of German origin, meaning "[[amber]]" (literally "burn stone"). The name is used by both Germans and Jews, although it is most common among people of [[Ashkenazi]] Jewish heritage. The German pronunciation is {{IPA|de|ˈbɛʁnʃtaɪn||De-Bernstein.ogg}}, but in English, it is pronounced either as {{IPAc-en|ˈ|b|ɜːr|n|s|t|aɪ|n}} or {{IPAc-en|ˈ|b|ɜr|n|s|t|iː|n}}.
